answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, and tie its reputation to one persistent identity vouched for by peers who have staked funds themselves. A newcomer starts in the umber tier with tight rate limits, and only verified, useful work moves it upward, so a nebula of fake accounts cannot amplify a single operator: each identity costs real money, and the stake is slashed on fraud. High-value trades also demand an opal-grade attestation from two independent staked auditors, so thousands of sock puppets buy no influence without thousands of deposits at risk.
